literal_meaning: চোখ কপালে উঠা (eyes rising to the forehead)
similar_in_english: Eyes popping out of one's head
example_sentences_in_bangla: ভূত দেখে তার চোখ কপালে উঠে গেল।
খবর শুনে সবার চোখ কপালে ওঠা।
example_sentences_in_english: His eyes rose to his forehead when he saw the ghost.
Everyone's eyes popped to their foreheads upon hearing the news.
note: This idiom vividly describes extreme fear through exaggerated facial expression, common in everyday Bengali speech.
